choice.basis: The dashboard shows a monotonically non-increasing Reservoir Storage Level Index from 23.9 in 2005 to 10.1 in 2014. The full-period change is a 13.8-point decrease (23.9 - 10.1 = 13.8), representing a roughly 58% drop in the storage index over the review period. This magnitude of decline across the entire 2005-2014 span indicates a substantial change in reservoir storage, warranting follow-up review rather than routine monitoring for ordinary variation.
choice.option_label: Route the 2005 to 2014 reservoir storage change to substantial-change follow-up
